known_good.tested: 2026-10-10 on the handheld together with the official fex-emu-wine 2610 modules: Quake III Arena timedemo 26.4 fps without NoExec, Worms Armageddon unchanged, Carmageddon 2 past NoExec

why: Valve's own wow64.dll is the half that tells FEX the process has DEP disabled (BTCpuNotifyProcessExecuteFlagsChange); the community Proton's Wine lacks the call. It is LSE-free, and it exists only inside Valve's Proton app, which Steam serves to signed-in accounts only (an anonymous login gets AccessDenied for its depot key: docs/WISPOS-NOTES.md). So Steam installs that app (the seeded default tool is the community one, so nothing else would) and wisp-wow64-valve copies this one file, ONLY when its sha256 is on known_good: an updated Valve build is never used until it has been tested and pinned here.
